official_public_evidence.establishes: The public query exposes processed SDR records and explicitly states that recently submitted SDRs are not available until FAA approval.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: the approval/publication timestamp of an individual historical SDR

official_public_evidence.establishes: FAA states that reports must complete Quality Control review before becoming publicly available and that SDR/Malfunction-or-Defect reports are converted to a common SDR format.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: the date on which a specific historical record completed quality control

official_public_evidence.artifact: FAA Download Service Difficulty Reports by Year
official_public_evidence.establishes: FAA currently publishes annual CSV downloads for SDR records by calendar year.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: that the current CSV contents or later corrections were publicly present at historical simulated cutoffs

official_public_evidence.establishes: FAA Service Difficulty Reports are permanent digital records, are cut off upon processing, cover records from 1999 onward, and transfer to the National Archives 20 years after cutoff.
official_public_evidence.does_not_establish: the processing/public-release timestamp of an individual report or an online historical snapshot for a simulated 2010-2025 cutoff

release_semantics.DifficultyDate: date of the service difficulty; outcome/occurrence timing, not public-release timing
release_semantics.SubmissionDate: submission timing; not public-release timing because FAA approval/QC precedes public availability
release_semantics.current_annual_csv: current processed-record snapshot for the selected difficulty year; may contain submissions, approvals, corrections or supplemental information that post-date the difficulty year

pit_implications: Current inclusion in a historical-year CSV does not prove that the record or its present field values were public at an earlier cutoff.

A record may be admitted to a strict historical backtest only when an approval/publication timestamp, archived public result, immutable dated release, or equivalent evidence establishes public availability no later than the simulated cutoff.
Supplemental/corrected values must not be back-projected to the original submission or difficulty date without version evidence.
coverage_gap: The current FAA public surfaces establish the approval/QC-before-publication rule and current annual downloads. NARA confirms that mandatory SDR records are permanent and cut off upon processing, but transfer occurs 20 years later and the public export lacks that processing/public-release timestamp. The project still has no online historical version sequence or record-level public-release timestamp for the 2010-2025 SDR population.
